name: Provider Access Is Denied
summary: The user selects Microsoft as the representative supported-provider permutation and cancels or denies authorization at the provider, returning to a deterministic recoverable access-denied surface without resolving a durable identity.

preconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and the provider round trip is configured to return access_denied

serverInteraction.intent: Normalize a provider cancellation or access_denied callback without resolving, creating, or linking a durable identity.

postconditions.expression: session-capability == anonymous and no durable identity was created, linked, or authenticated

sourceReferences.note: External Identity Provider category reconciliation separates linked-subject sign-in, provider denial/fault, first-time registration, and provider link/unlink management while preserving provider-specific choices as permutations.
